ask_ai: Ask your AI assistant anything about your business or for help using the app.
menu: Open the main menu to find more tools, settings, and help guides.
help_center: Visit our Help Center for step-by-step guides and answers to common questions.
quick_actions_hint: These are shortcuts to the tasks you'll do most often to run your business.
grow_business: Find new ways to get more customers and grow your sales.
referrals: Invite friends to OHC and earn rewards for your business.
stats: See a simple summary of how your business is performing today.
share: Get a link to your store that you can share on social media or with customers.
add_product: List a new item or service for sale in your store.
view_orders: See a list of recent orders from your customers.
messages: Read and reply to messages from your customers.
active_helpers: These are your AI teammates working in the background to help you.
active_help: These are the tasks your AI helpers are currently working on for you.
todays_sales: The total amount of money your business has made from sales today.
orders_to_ship: New orders from customers that you need to prepare or ship.
generative_score: A measure of how much your AI helpers are contributing to your business growth.
telemetry_rag: The speed at which your AI helpers can find and use your business information.
telemetry_cache: How often your AI helpers can quickly reuse previous work to save time.
connect_apps: Connect OHC to other tools you use to run your business (for advanced users).
